title: Localized cartesian base change for a relatively flat single sheaf
statement: Under the geometric hypotheses of lem-pc-cartesian-flat-single-termwise-comparison (quasi-compact quasi-separated f:X->S and p:Y->W, quasi-coherent M flat over p, nested opens U and V, a cartesian square q:X times_S V -> Y over g:V->W, and q^*M isomorphic to the restriction of F), the localized restriction over V of the restriction over U of Rf_*F[0] is isomorphic to localizedMixedDerivedPullback(U,V,W,g) applied to Rp_*M[0]. All source, target, auxiliary and localized-site derived-category universes are independently supplied as in the Lean signature. This has no complex P, representative isomorphism, or termwise functor L in its hypotheses or conclusion.

proof.text: Use open derived direct-image restriction for the nested opens and identify the restricted coefficient sheaf with q^*M using the supplied sheaf isomorphism. Transport to the cartesian pullback scheme.

Apply relatively flat complex tensor base change to p with perfect unit O_Y[0] and G=M[0]. Tensor unit comparisons remove the unit, producing Lg^*Rp_*M[0]. Identify the given cartesian square with the canonical pullback square.

Use canonical localization equivalences to compare independently supplied universes. Compute right-derived images using a common K-injective resolution. Apply the exact inverse overEquiv V to obtain precisely the explicit localized mixed pullback.
